ROW.COLUMN: (FR/AC) Rapid Movement of Funds - All Activity

Fraud schemes, particularly those involving multiple accounts or customers, can often be detected through a sudden increase in the velocity of funds through a particular account or accounts. This could be indicative of an identity theft or account takeover scheme, where in the fraudster has gained access to a legitimate customer's account and is moving funds through it and out of the institution. Or it could be indicative of a fraudster's account, illegitimately opened, through which the fraudster is consolidating and transferring out funds which has been defrauded from the institution's customers. The scenario detects both new accounts/customers and more seasoned accounts/customers that move transactions of all types in and out of an account or accounts within a specified lookback period. The scenario can take into account the amount or velocity of funds through the account relative to the account balance or net worth.
